pages.title: Antimatter Pellet
pages.text: A small cloud of antimatter levitated in the middle of a Penning trap, held by electric and magnetic fields so that it touches nothing. If it did touch anything, both would vanish into gamma rays. Through the window it is a speck of light hanging very still, which is the reassuring part.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Firing entangled photon pairs into a heavy nucleus produced electron-positron pairs. With a superconducting coil and superfluid helium, the Antimatter Penning Trap caught the positrons before they met anything.
